Software Engineering Intern — Summer 2026
Kestrel Systems | Bengaluru, India

About the role
You will join our platform team building internal developer tooling used by
every engineer at Kestrel. You will own a small project end to end, with a
mentor, and ship it to production before your internship ends.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain REST APIs in Python
- Write unit and integration tests for the code you ship
- Participate in code review with senior engineers
- Debug production issues alongside the on-call engineer

Required qualifications
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- Strong programming fundamentals in Python or Java
- Working knowledge of Git and version control workflows
- Understanding of data structures and algorithms
- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with Django or Flask
- Exposure to Docker and containerised development
- Prior internship or substantial personal projects
- Contributions to open source

We review applications on a rolling basis.
